CURRENT_TECHNICAL_BOUNDARY: Whole workspace and/tmp writable per supplied session contract; protected .git does not make old docs/source read-only
ENFORCEMENT: Prospective requirements only; no new store, mount, host permission, wrapper or writable campaign created
PRIOR_FILE_HASH_COMPARISONS: After-the-fact independent preservation verification; cannot prevent a transient destructive write or restore lost history

REQUIRED_RULES.ATOMIC_REPLACEMENT: Create exclusive bounded temp in approved private same-filesystem directory, fsync then approved replace only if previous expected state/seal matches; charge every immutable snapshot in full before any write
REQUIRED_RULES.FAILURE_EVIDENCE: Sole independent critical writer with protected reserve2336bytes; ordinary writers cannot access reserve; explicit INCOMPLETE on incomplete causal/undurable evidence
REQUIRED_RULES.HARD_LINK: Reject nlink other than1 or unmanaged alias before replace; reject existing unknown inode/owner
REQUIRED_RULES.PATH_TRAVERSAL: Resolve from held approved root descriptors; reject absolute/unapproved relative paths and dot-dot; no arbitrary supplied destination
REQUIRED_RULES.RETENTION: Keep immutable pre-entry seals, counters, failures and final audit; no cleanup refunds or retry reset
REQUIRED_RULES.SYMLINK: Reject every traversed symlink; descriptor no-follow and independent parent/device ownership checks
REQUIRED_RULES.TEMP_AND_CACHES: Explicit private allowance charged to evidence if content publication; no arbitrary /tmp/cache writes, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE and disabled target import/test collection; environment pin and kernel confinement still needed
